```plato

    // The midpoints introduced by a split, in edge order: the block appended to
    // the position array.
    SplitMidpoints(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, splitMask: Array<Boolean>): Array<Point3D>
        => splitMask.Count.MapRange(e => e).Reduce(Repeat(0, Point3D.Origin), (acc, e) =>
            splitMask[e] ? acc.Append(self.EdgeMidpoint(topology, UndirectedEdgeIndex(e))) : acc);
```
